zh.title: 美國空軍頒發最高安全獎 表揚F-22機腹著陸飛行員
zh.summary: 美國空軍參謀長頒發最高飛行安全獎；表揚F-22飛行員主輪脫落後成功機腹著陸
body: 美國空軍參謀長肯·威爾斯巴赫（Ken Wilsbach）上將於2026年9月8日在五角大廈舉行頒獎典禮，頒發2025年科倫·科利吉安二世獎座（Koren Kolligian Jr. Trophy）給第3作戰群第90戰鬥機隊的麥可·克隆寧格（Michael Cloninger）上尉。該獎項為美國空軍最高榮譽的飛行安全獎，旨在表揚在緊急狀況下展露卓越飛行技術並成功避免嚴重事故或損害的飛行員。
這起受獎事件源於2024年9月18日，當時克隆寧格上尉部署於美國中央司令部責任區內，正擔任四機編隊的二號機執行不列顛空戰紀念飛行任務。戰機自機場起飛後，該架F-22猛禽（F-22 Raptor）隱形戰機的右側主輪組突然脫落。編隊隨即中止任務並於機場附近盤旋，經編隊長機確認，戰機右側主輪組已完全脫落。
由於當時無任何現行操作手冊涵蓋此項故障，克隆寧格上尉選擇執行機腹著陸檢查表，排除單側主輪與裸露支柱降落的方案。克隆寧格上尉在空中盤旋約一小時以消耗燃油，同時與塔台、緊急救援小組及作戰主管保持密切協調。隨後他使用緊急備用襟翼設定低空通場，並以平緩且符合標準速度的角度著陸於跑道中心線。
美國空軍指出，這起精準的機腹著陸成功阻止了落地後可能引發的火災事故。克隆寧格上尉在戰機停妥後立即關閉雙發動機並完成緊急撤離。該架價值約1.56億美元的戰機在經過系統診斷與評估後，已成功飛離戰區。美國空軍將此稱為機腹著陸F-22戰機歷史上前所未有的成功回收案例。
科倫·科利吉安二世獎座是美國空軍唯一由參謀長親自頒發的飛行安全獎項。該獎座由1955年9月14日駕駛T-33 Shooting Star教練機於加州海岸失蹤的科倫·科利吉安二世中尉家族所創立，用以表揚在空中危急時刻展現卓越處置能力、成功保護人員與飛機安全之機組人員。

en.title: US Air Force awards highest safety trophy to F-22 pilot following belly landing
en.summary: US Air Force presents top safety trophy to F-22 pilot following Middle East emergency landing.
body: US Air Force Chief of Staff General Ken Wilsbach presented the 2025 Koren Kolligian Jr. Trophy to Captain Michael Cloninger of the 90th Fighter Squadron, 3rd Operations Group, during a ceremony at the Pentagon on September 8, 2026. The trophy represents the US Air Force's most prestigious flight safety award and recognizes exceptional airmanship during emergencies where aircrew prevent accidents or minimize damage and loss of life.

The award stems from an incident on September 18, 2024, while Cloninger was deployed to the US Central Command area of responsibility. Flying as number two in a four-ship formation during a Battle of Britain anniversary flyover, the right main wheel assembly separated from Cloninger's F-22 Raptor immediately after takeoff. The flight aborted the primary mission and remained close to the airfield while the flight lead confirmed that the entire right main wheel assembly was missing.

Facing an unprecedented system failure with no established checklist procedure, Cloninger selected the gear-up landing procedure rather than risking an asymmetrical touchdown on a bare strut. He circled for approximately one hour to burn off excessive fuel while coordinating emergency response actions with air traffic control and operations supervisors. He then performed a shallow, on-speed approach, achieving a centerline touchdown that successfully prevented a post-landing fire.

Following the touchdown, Cloninger shut down both engines and completed an emergency egress from the aircraft. US Air Force maintenance teams evaluated the stealth fighter on site and subsequently flew the $156 million airframe out of the operational theater after diagnostics. Military officials described the total preservation and return to service of the aircraft as an unprecedented recovery for a belly-landed F-22 Raptor.

The Koren Kolligian Jr. Trophy is the only safety award presented personally by the US Air Force Chief of Staff. It was established by the family of First Lieutenant Koren Kolligian Jr., a pilot whose T-33 Shooting Star disappeared off the coast of California on September 14, 1955, to honor military aircrew who demonstrate extraordinary skill during critical flight emergencies.

zh.title: 美國聯邦航空總署提議以噪音標準取代長達53年的陸地上空超音速飛行禁令
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署提出新計畫，擬以噪音標準取代53年的陸地超音速飛行禁令。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）提出了一項新規劃，擬以具體的噪音標準，取代實施長達 53 年的陸地上空超音速飛行禁令。
這項由美國聯邦航空總署發布的提案，旨在提出以噪音標準取代既有陸地上空飛行禁令的架構。Simple Flying 指出，該項法規擬議之變更可能對商業超音速航空帶來影響。
此次提案標誌著針對陸地上空超音速飛行管制的擬議調整，將現行長達 53 年的陸地禁令轉向依據噪音標準進行規範的新政策方向。

en.title: FAA Proposes Replacing 53-Year Overland Supersonic Flight Ban With Noise Standard
en.summary: The FAA proposed replacing its 53-year overland supersonic flight ban with a new noise standard.
body: According to Simple Flying, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has proposed replacing its 53-year-old ban on supersonic flight over land with a new regulatory noise standard.
The proposed rule change aims to transition from the current prohibition on overland supersonic flights to a standard based on defined noise limits.
The regulatory initiative marks a significant potential shift for overland supersonic operations, replacing rules that have been in place for 53 years with specific noise compliance criteria.
Simple Flying noted that the FAA's proposed replacement of the long-standing supersonic flight ban could impact the future development of commercial aviation.

zh.title: 瑞安航空波音737 MAX於都柏林降落遭遇強側風翼尖擦地重飛
zh.summary: 瑞安航空波音737 MAX於都柏林強側風中翼尖觸地；乘客畫面記錄驟滾與重飛
body: 一架由瑞安航空營運的波音737 MAX客機，在都柏林降落期間遭遇強烈側風。客機在著陸過程中翼尖擦過地面，機組人員隨即中斷降落程序並進行重飛。
據乘客拍攝的現場影片畫面顯示，該架波音737 MAX客機在都柏林降落時受強陣風影響，機身出現驟然滾轉，並引發機翼翼尖與地面觸碰。
這起翼尖擦地與中斷降落事件發生於都柏林強側風天氣。客機在翼尖接觸地面後隨即拉升重飛，相關驟滾與翼尖觸地過程均被乘客影片記錄。

en.title: Ryanair Boeing 737 MAX Scrapes Wingtip and Aborts Dublin Landing in Crosswinds
en.summary: Ryanair Boeing 737 MAX wingtip contacts ground during Dublin crosswind landing; passenger video captures sudden roll.
body: A Ryanair Boeing 737 MAX aircraft scraped its wingtip and aborted a landing in Dublin after encountering severe crosswinds on final approach. The flight was attempting to land when challenging wind conditions impacted the aircraft's control.

Video captured by a passenger onboard documented the sudden roll and wingtip contact amid strong gusts in Dublin. The recording shows the aircraft rolling unexpectedly toward the ground before the flight crew initiated an aborted landing.

Following the wingtip scrape, the crew aborted the Dublin landing procedure to regain altitude in the strong gusts. The sudden roll and subsequent wingtip contact were captured on the passenger's video.

zh.title: La Compagnie預計2027年開航紐約至杜塞道夫全商務艙航線
zh.summary: 法國La Compagnie預計於2027年春季開航紐威克至杜塞道夫全商務艙航線
body: 法國全商務艙航空公司La Compagnie宣布，計畫於2027年春季開辦往返美國紐威克自由國際機場與德國杜塞道夫機場（DUS）的直飛航線。這項新營運計畫旨在提供全商務艙服務，於夏季高峰期間預計每週提供最多五個班次，滿足跨大西洋航線對頂級商務與休閒旅遊的需求。
在機隊配置與執飛機型方面，La Compagnie預計投入空中巴士 A321LR 機型執行該條航線。該款客機內部配備76席可全平躺的商務艙座位，採用每排2-2的座位配置，並提供乘客無限速高速Wi-Fi網路、機上娛樂系統、餐點及免費香檳等服務。
這項杜塞道夫航線的擴展計畫，將與該航空公司預計於2027年交付的第三架空中巴士 A321LR 機型相配合。此外，La Compagnie亦規劃於2028年引進第四架客機空中巴士 A321XLR，藉由新一代客機更高燃油效益與更長航程能力，提供未來跨大西洋航線部署的靈活性。
出發與抵達機場的地面服務方面，搭乘該航線的乘客於杜塞道夫機場可使用位於C區登機廊廳的DUS Sky Lounge貴賓室；自紐威克出發的旅客則可使用航空公司專屬的Lounge&Co貴賓室設施。
目前La Compagnie已營運自紐威克飛往法國巴黎奧利機場、尼斯蔚藍海岸機場以及義大利米蘭馬爾彭薩機場等地的定期航線。隨著2027年杜塞道夫航線的加入，該航空公司將成為提供紐約與杜塞道夫之間唯一直飛服務的航空公司。

en.title: La Compagnie Plans All-Business-Class Flights Between Newark and Düsseldorf in 2027
en.summary: La Compagnie plans spring 2027 launch for Newark to Düsseldorf all-business-class service.
body: French boutique airline La Compagnie has announced plans to launch all-business-class non-stop flights between Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) and Düsseldorf Airport (DUS) starting in spring 2027. The scheduled transatlantic service is expected to operate up to five times per week during the summer season, addressing strong demand for premium transatlantic travel between the New York metropolitan area and North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany's most populous state.

The carrier intends to deploy an Airbus A321LR aircraft on the route, configured with 76 lie-flat business-class seats arranged in a 2-2 layout. Passengers traveling on the service will receive access to full onboard amenities, including unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi connection, dedicated inflight entertainment, complimentary meals, and Champagne service throughout the flight.

The network expansion to Düsseldorf coincides with the scheduled arrival of a third Airbus A321LR aircraft to the airline's fleet in 2027. Furthermore, La Compagnie plans to add a fourth aircraft, an Airbus A321XLR, to its fleet in 2028. According to the airline, these newer aircraft are expected to be quieter and up to 30 percent more fuel-efficient than previous-generation models, while offering extended flight range for future transatlantic routes.

Ground accommodations at the airports will provide passengers with dedicated lounge access. Customers departing from Düsseldorf Airport will have access to the DUS Sky Lounge located in Pier C, while passengers flying out of Newark Liberty International Airport will be able to use the airline's dedicated Lounge&Co facility prior to boarding.

La Compagnie currently operates transatlantic non-stop flights from Newark to Paris Orly, Nice Côte d’Azur, and Milan Malpensa, and has also extended its New York to Nice service into the winter season for the first time. Upon launching the new service in 2027, La Compagnie will become the only airline offering a direct, non-stop flight connection between New York and Düsseldorf.

zh.title: Hermeus研發Ramjet-X子母無人機 預計2027年展開整合測試
zh.summary: Hermeus發表Ramjet-X子母無人機系統；預計2027年展開整合測試
body: 航太初創企業 Hermeus 宣布，正研發一款名為 Ramjet-X 的可拋棄式衝壓引擎自主飛行器。該飛行器設計由其尺寸與 F-16 相當的 Quarterhorse 無人機進行空中發射。Ramjet-X 長約 22 英呎、寬約 7 英呎，將使 Quarterhorse Mk 3 成為載機母機，Ramjet-X 則作為寄生飛行器運作。
根據 Hermeus 的概念規劃，Quarterhorse 無人機將於翼下掛架攜帶 Ramjet-X，每趟任務最多可攜帶兩架。母機需以約 3 馬赫的高速進行釋放，以提供 Ramjet-X 啟動衝壓引擎所需的高初始速度。釋放後，Ramjet-X 將爬升至約 10 萬英呎高度，並以約 4 馬赫的速度飛行，運作速度位於 5 馬赫極音速門檻以下。
目前 Hermeus 正位於美國佛羅里達州傑克遜維爾的 HEAT 測試設施，對 Ramjet-X 的衝壓引擎進行測試。公司規劃於 2027 年展開載具整合測試。透過利用可重複使用的 Quarterhorse 平台與較小的 Ramjet-X 飛行器，客戶無須為每趟實驗飛行建造專用的測試載具。
Hermeus 表示，Ramjet-X 將使其能夠提供高馬赫飛行測試即服務（FTaaS），進一步擴大進入過往昂貴且難以達成的飛行環境。該平台可整合酬載、感測器、通訊、自主控制系統、材料樣品及各類實驗性軟硬體。Hermeus 執行長 Zach Shore 指出，高速飛行測試成本極為昂貴且機會有限，Ramjet-X 能降低取得極具價值數據的門檻。
此外，Hermeus 也是目前已知計畫競逐美國空軍協同戰鬥航空器（CCA）第二階段計畫的九家廠商之一。多數 CCA 概念飛行器採次音速設計，而 Hermeus 則致力於研發超音速與極音速自主飛行器。

en.title: Hermeus Unveils Air-Launched Ramjet-X Drone for High-Mach Testing
en.summary: Hermeus announced its Ramjet-X autonomous vehicle launch platform, planning integrated vehicle testing to begin in 2027.
body: Aerospace startup Hermeus has announced the development of an expendable, ramjet-powered autonomous vehicle designated Ramjet-X. Designed to air-launch from the company's F-16-sized Quarterhorse drone, the new vehicle measures approximately 22 feet in length and 7 feet in width. Under the mothership-parasite concept, the Quarterhorse Mk 3 will carry up to two Ramjet-X vehicles under its wing pylons.

The operational concept relies on Quarterhorse releasing the Ramjet-X at a release speed of around Mach 3, providing the high initial speed necessary for the ramjet engine to initiate. Following launch, Ramjet-X is designed to climb to an altitude of around 100,000 feet and operate at speeds of around Mach 4, placing its operational regime just below the Mach 5 hypersonic threshold.

Hermeus is currently conducting ground testing of the Ramjet-X ramjet engine at its HEAT facility in Jacksonville, Florida. The company plans for integrated vehicle testing to commence in 2027. By leveraging the reusable Quarterhorse launch platform together with the smaller expendable vehicle, organizations will be able to perform high-Mach experimental flights without requiring bespoke test vehicles.

According to Hermeus, Ramjet-X will allow the contractor to offer high-Mach Flight Test as a Service (FTaaS), opening access to flight test environments that have historically been costly and difficult to reach. The platform can integrate experimental payloads, sensors, communications hardware, autonomy systems, material samples, and software. Hermeus CEO Zach Shore emphasized that high-speed flight testing is extremely expensive and that Ramjet-X lowers barriers to gathering valuable data.

Additionally, Hermeus is among the nine acknowledged vendors planning to compete for the US Air Force's Increment 2 Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) programme. While most competing CCA concepts focus on subsonic capabilities, Hermeus aims to develop supersonic autonomous aircraft with long-term plans for high-speed flight technology.
